gloss: tent, move tent from place to place
definition: [ אָהַל ] verb denominative tent, move tent from place to place (compare Assyrian â'ilu (?) Dl W No. 4 & Agl ) וַיֶּאֱהַל Gen 13:12 ; Gen 13:18 ( J ), compare ישֵׁב אֹהֶל (see אֹהֶל ); Pi`el Imperfect יַהֵל (contracted for יְאַהֵל ) pitch one's tent like nomad Isa 13:20 .
definition_html:
BDB155 [H167]

BDB154 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB156

[אָהַל] verb denominative tent, move tent from place to place (compare Assyrian â'ilu (?) DlW No. 4 & Agl) וַיֶּאֱהַל Gen 13:12; Gen 13:18 (J), compare ישֵׁב אֹהֶל (see אֹהֶל); Pi`el Imperfect יַהֵל (contracted for יְאַהֵל) pitch one's tent like nomad Isa 13:20.
